rt:model.rt:sub: Sub SetIndicatorStatics (ByVal obj As RtSvgObj, ByVal pv As PlsPVBin, ByVal TPTSBitNr As UShort) If (obj == Nothing) Then Exit Sub ElseIf (pv == Nothing) Then obj.visibility = "hidden" End If Dim RealBitNr As UShort Dim mask As UShort RealBitNr = 16 - TPTSBitNr mask = 2 ** RealBitNr obj.title = obj.title + " - " + PRJSPEC.Get_BST_Descr(pv.PVId, RealBitNr) obj.fill_opacity = 1.0 - 0.75 * CDbl((pv.ProjSpecNr1 & mask) / mask) End Sub
